description: This file defines the CredentialsRepository class, which manages credential data using Prisma ORM in a NestJS application. It includes methods for upserting, finding, retrieving, and deleting credentials, and references external Prisma services and constants.

classes.name: CredentialsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing credentials in the database, providing methods for CRUD operations and queries based on user and team IDs.

methods.name: upsertUserAppCredential
methods.description: Creates or updates a user credential record based on provided type, key, userId, and optional credentialId.

methods.name: upsertTeamAppCredential
methods.description: Creates or updates a team credential record based on provided type, key, teamId, and optional credentialId.

methods.name: findCredentialByTypeAndUserId
methods.description: Finds the first credential matching the specified type and userId.

methods.name: findAllCredentialsByTypeAndUserId
methods.description: Finds all credentials matching the specified type and userId.

methods.name: findCredentialByTypeAndTeamId
methods.description: Finds the first credential matching the specified type and teamId.

methods.name: findAllCredentialsByTypeAndTeamId
methods.description: Finds all credentials matching the specified type and teamId.

methods.name: getAllUserCredentialsByTypeAndId
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a user of a specific type.

methods.name: getUserCredentialsByIds
methods.description: Retrieves credentials by userId and list of credentialIds, including user email.

methods.name: getAllUserCredentialsById
methods.description: Retrieves all credentials for a user, ordered by ID, with specific fields.

methods.name: getUserCredentialById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific credential for a user by credentialId and type.

methods.name: deleteUserCredentialById
methods.description: Deletes a user credential by userId and credentialId.
